<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 114.06808. Assuming this is the molecular ion (no adduct), the neutral monoisotopic mass is 114.06808 Da. The formula C₆H₁₀O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 114.06808 Da and yields an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 2), making it a chemically plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
